title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch Solid Brass, 3-Tier Wall Mount | Fire Engine Red | Allied Brass
short_title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch, Fire Engine Red
description:
Stop stacking towels on a hook or the counter—add dedicated storage and a built-in drying area in one wall-mounted piece in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. This traditional towel shelf with drying rack brings classic bath accessories styling to everyday organization, making it easy to keep folded towels ready while wet towels air out.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maintain a clean, refined look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Match your traditional bathroom hardware with multiple designer finish options available
- Get lasting confidence with a Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs & Installation:
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Dimensions (L x W x H): 24.7 in x 8.9 in x 10.4 in
- Projection: 3.5 in
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly: Some assembly required
- Included: Towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
